data.name: Medieval - Embers of War 2
data.detailed_description:
Medieval Embers of War 2 is a top-down co-op RPG that mixes action, strategy, and battlefield control in a colorful low-poly medieval world.

Take control of a hero and fight alongside your allies in battles where you don't fight alone. Call in units to support you, capture strategic points across the battlefield, and push back an enemy force that has access to the same tools and abilities you do.

⚔️ Fight Together

Team up with up to 4 players in local co-op and take on the battlefield together. Each player controls their own hero while managing their units and working with the rest of the team.

🛡️ RPG Meets Strategy

You are more than just a hero running into battle. Your decisions on the battlefield matter.

Call in the right units, capture and hold strategic points, choose where to fight, and use your forces to create an advantage. The enemy isn't just waiting to be defeated — the AI can use the same battlefield mechanics and capabilities available to you.

🗺️ Campaign

An introductory, objective-based campaign takes you through a series of battles designed to teach you the game's mechanics while gradually introducing new gameplay elements.

⚔️ Skirmish Battles

Skirmish mode is free-form battle. Capture battlefield points, build your forces, disrupt the enemy, and push toward their camp. The outcome comes down to how well you play your strategy and control the battlefield.

🔥 Your Battlefield, Your Strategy

Medieval Embers of War 2 is built around simple ideas: fight together, make smart decisions, and take control of the battlefield.

Whether you're working with friends in co-op or testing your strategy against the AI, every battle gives you the freedom to decide where to fight, which forces to bring, and how to turn the tide in your favor.

Gather your allies. Take control of the battlefield. Make your stand.

data.short_description: Lead your hero and fight alongside your allies in this top-down co-op RPG. Call in units, capture strategic points, and outmaneuver an enemy that can use the same forces against you. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players in local co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel 1.2 Ghz or equivalent
  • Graphics: Intel (R) HD Graphics or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: The game might run on lower specs, but that configuration will not be supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel 1.6 Ghz or equivalent
  • Graphics: GeForce or ATI Graphic Accelerator
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
